A.name: Route A — preparation belongs to the insertion

predecessor_definitions.XII-C_eq:selected-action: S_grav,D = S_EH + kappa int (sigma-1) ell_3  (ACTION-level cubic weighting)
predecessor_definitions.XVI-M_graph_vertex: V(h) = int chi_I ell_3(h) with chi_I independent of sigma_eps (graph insertion switch)
predecessor_definitions.XVI-M_conventions: relation of chi_I to action weighting kappa int sigma ell_3 is NOT fixed (Unresolved in XVI-M)

A.reason: XII-C places sigma in the selected gravitational ACTION (cubic-only weight), not merely in a composite insertion. The graph switch chi_I is a separate object (XVI-K/XVI-L/XVI-M). Predecessor definitions do not identify preparation with the insertion.

B.name: Route B — external transforming background
B.reason: Would require introducing a transformation law for sigma and an invariant completion, then specializing to the fixed ramp. XII-C already treats sigma as a fixed external weight and computes the resulting classical breaking; constructing a new invariant completion is a different theory than the actual prepared action.
B.note: Declaring the ramp a scalar is not a proof that the existing cubic modification is invariant (plan N.1).

C.name: Route C — preparation explicitly breaks gauge symmetry
C.justification: XII-C Theorem thm:noether (Changed Noether identity) already proves the actual prepared action has a known classical breaking, distinct from any quantum anomaly. Breaking includes: (i) ramp-derivative terms Rampdef_sigma from Dsource; (ii) bulk coefficient mismatch -w Q_nu(A gamma) from weighting only the cubic while leaving the quadratic unweighted; (iii) separate gauge-fixing breaking N(e_gf) when S_gf is included. Relates to XI-A thm:noether B_nu (switching) but is not a relabeling of it.
classical_breaking_terms: N_nu(e_gf) if gauge-fixed (XI-A prop:gfbad; linear breaking -Box D^nu)
predecessor_labels: XI-A thm:noether / eq:B (related switching pattern, different object)
